firstPlayerRule: Give the Brenn marker to a random player for setup. In the Season phase, the current Brenn plays the first card, which must be a Season card.
clarifications: The setup Brenn chooses the Capital and flips the Flock of Crows token. Initial clan placement begins with the Brenn and follows the token’s direction.

Before each Season, the Assembly gives the Brenn marker to the Capital’s chieftain, if there is one; otherwise the current Brenn keeps it. The Assembly also flips the Flock of Crows token to set turn direction.
